description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Dark with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Crystal Force Mode], and [Crystal Force Mode: Cloud (Dark)] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force I
description.text: One single attack (2.00) capped at 199999, grants [Dark Ability +30% Boost 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user. After using Crystal Force command twice, grants [True Damage Cap 199999 1] and [Dark Ability Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force II
description.text: One single attack (2.00) capped at 199999, grants [Dark Ability +30% Boost 2], [DEF and RES 50% Piercing 2], and [200% ATB 1] to the user. After using Crystal Force command twice, grants [True Damage Cap 199999 1] and [Dark Ability Instant Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Cloud (Dark)
description.text: Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time, [DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)], removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode

description.name: DEF and RES 25% Piercing (15s)
description.text: Ignores 25% of the target's DEF and RES

description.name: Attach Dark with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Dark Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Dark 3

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions
